name: IntuneManagement - Read-only inventory
purpose: Read Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, applications and settings catalog policy metadata. Optionally inventory managed devices. Display and export a sanitized report without changing tenant objects.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.label: Tenant ID or verified tenant domain
parameters.help: Microsoft Entra tenant GUID or verified domain, for example contoso.onmicrosoft.com. Used by the launcher's device-code sign-in.

parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.label: Public client application ID
parameters.help: Application ID of an existing public-client app registration configured for device-code authentication and the read-only delegated Graph permissions described in directions.txt.

parameters.name: IncludeDevices
parameters.label: Include managed device inventory
parameters.help: Also requests DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All and reads a restricted set of device inventory fields. Device names are included; recovery/bypass codes and user contact details are excluded.

outcomes: Policy and application inventory, collection counts, and optional device records.
Per-collection status so access failures are distinguishable from empty results.
Local Markdown and JSON files with LLM processing instructions.
notes: No policy or tenant setting is changed.
This is a scoped inventory. It does not include assignments, effective policy or every settings catalog value.
Microsoft sign-in is separate from saved directory and Azure application credentials. Its access token is reused in launcher memory and cleared on exit.
prerequisites: Your Microsoft Entra tenant ID or verified tenant domain, such as contoso.onmicrosoft.com.
The application ID of an existing public client registration configured for device-code sign-in.
The read permissions listed in Technical details, an Intune license, and an account with visibility into the intended scope.
steps: Open Parameters. Enter your tenant and the public client application ID.
Optionally select Include managed device inventory.
Choose Run report. Sign-in instructions and a one-time code will appear in the status area.
Complete Microsoft sign-in in your browser, then return to the launcher for the report.
guide.overview: Review Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, applications and settings catalog policy metadata. Optionally include a limited device inventory.
